records.name: google.com
records.description: Demo override for an arbitrary real domain. It intentionally shows the public-DNS conflict flow; remove it before production.

records.name: hello.fdn
records.description: Basic demo record used by the extension's offline sample registry.

records.name: docs.fdn
records.description: Documentation demo record; plain HTTP in v1.

records.name: secure.fdn
records.description: HTTPS target demo for the auto-continue path. The certificate is example.org's normal certificate; v1 does not provide custom-TLD TLS.
